# Mapping Africa: crop field boundary labels for Africa, 2017-2023

Mapping Africa field boundaries (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Agricultural Impacts Research Group, Clark University. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna/latest/lacuna.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4326; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: geometry, determination:datetime, admin:country_code, site, assignment_id, label_class, labeller, qscore, rscore, label_category, completion_time, metrics:area, id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/lacuna/collection.json
